results.content: Moreover, it conducted case study research of the digital preservation of various world heritage sites across the world initiated by Global Digital Heritage, a non-profit private organization of research and education that uses 3D virtualization, geospatial informatics, and open-access solutions to create 3D models of global cultural heritage and CyArk, a California-based company that uses 3D technology to make cultural heritage accessible to a global audience. Most of the conservation processes include advanced technologies like 3D modeling and VR tools within the metaverse to provide enhanced immersive experiences in cultural heritage documentation, preservation, virtual visits, and cultural education. The study collected and analyzed 49 publications from Google Scholar, spanning from 2020 to 2024, and conducted case studies on 3D models of UNESCO World Heritage sites developed by Global Digital Heritage and CyArk. Its findings reported increased use of advanced metaverse-based technologies in creating accurate and immersive virtual replicas of cultural heritage sites.
